services.name: Rental Spaces
services.desc: Starlight Theatre has 10 event spaces - five indoor, including two with outdoor access, and five outdoor-only - that can accommodate any event. Special Event Rentals between April and October may be possible based on campus availability. Additional costs will apply in order to change over the space for special event use. The Jeannette and Jerome Cohen Community Stage House is available for special event rentals mid-October to early April*. Events are held on the climate-controlled, fully enclosed stage.
